hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'Co-Authored-By:.*Claude|Claude-Session:|anthropic\.com|claude\.ai'; then jq -n --arg msg 'Blocked: this command contains Claude or Anthropic attribution (Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session, anthropic.com, or claude.ai). Remove it and retry without that attribution.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$msg}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
